director.summary:
I watched the preview at 390 px wide (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-visitor-counter-api/1e0f8dbb-d731-5965-a898-07519c7bdbc3/scratchpad/r6/review/director/phone390.mp4) and frame by frame at 1080x1920. I measured frame-to-frame differences, backdrop colour, bun and lens positions, and sharpness.

**What works**
- **Rhythm:** all 9 internal cuts land exactly on f150, 165, 180, 195, 210, 225, 240, 255 and 270. Every other frame-to-frame change stays at or below 7 levels, apart from the planned moves: the lens slides and drops and the bun drop. It does feel like a cut every half second on the beat.
- **No flicker or colour jumps:** the backdrop drifts 3 levels at most inside a beat. Lime is a constant (198,255,0). The mp4 matches the rendered PNGs to within about 1.4 levels.
- **Oud smoke:** the R3-12 fade looks natural. There is no hard ceiling and at most 1 level is left above y 880.
- **Burger seeds:** none are left floating.
- **Kunafa A to B:** the tray stays in place and the world around it turns lime. This match cut works well.
- **Bun hang and drop:** the hang reads as a deliberate speed ramp and the drop is clean. On screen the bun top goes from y 892 (held f210-218) to 896, 910, 938, 973, 1010 and 1059 (f219-224). It speeds up steadily, falls straight (x 340-745) and stays 59 px or more below the tag.
- **Instantly named at 390 px:** all four worlds read. Burger is the strongest. Kunafa reads as "a sweet" more than "kunafa".

**What needs fixing (all zero-credit)**
1. **Burger impact bounces up (f225-f235).** After the bun lands, it rises 19 px on screen in 3 frames and sways about 20 px each side. This is the "burger moving upward" the owner mocked before.
2. **Burger lens entrance (f240-f241).** The first frame of the drop puts the burger lens behind «برجر؟» and against the word.
3. **Coffee A repeats the crash.** f135-149 is the fifth showing of the same ice crash and crown in 5 s, and it ends on the n18 crown the owner is still judging.
4. **Coffee lens (f150-164) is the weakest world.** It is the softest picture and still carries the R3-22c bean and streak, which were not retouched.

The lens entrances otherwise read as intentional:
- **Coffee:** the rim shrinks while the picture stays still. It is subtle.
- **Oud:** a clean slide-in, with no smear.

The other findings below are polish.

Nothing in the repository was changed; HANDOFF.md was not updated, because the repo is read-only for this role. Evidence is in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-visitor-counter-api/1e0f8dbb-d731-5965-a898-07519c7bdbc3/scratchpad/r6/review/director/: crops/ and sheets/ (p_135.jpg … p_270.jpg, phone_keyframes.png).

layout.summary:
I checked all 150 frames of the f135-f284 preview. Most of the layout, Arabic and colour rules hold, but four problems need fixing before the owner sees it.

**Must fix:**
- **L1:** At f240-f241 the burger lens drops through «مشروعك» and «برجر؟», and the tag sits on the burger.
- **L2:** The kunafa squiggle (R3-23) was not retouched. It shows on f255-f271 and looks like an insect leg.
- **L3:** The coffee bean and streak (R3-22c) were not retouched, and the 1.3x lens magnifies them on f150-f164.
- **L4:** The burger in the lens sits 61 px low, with only 5 px between the board and the rim. Moving the source point to (540,1355) centres it with 38 px clear.

**Minor:**
- **L5:** At f180 the word's shadow touches the tag's keyline.
- **L6:** The word's 1.04 pulse leaves Zone A by 4 px on the first frame of each cut.
- **L7:** The dots type on a 15-frame period; the spec says 30.
- **L8:** There is a faint colour step at y 30 on Burger A.
- **L9:** The board's right edge enters the TikTok rail on Burger B.
- **L10:** The two lens entries do not move as the spec describes.

**What passed (measured):**
- **Colour rules:** correct on every frame. On footage the word is Paper with an 8 px Ink keyline and +8 shadow, the tag is Lime with a 10 px Ink keyline, and the dots are Lime with an Ink ring and shadow. On Lime the word is Ink with a 6 px Paper keyline, the tag is Ink with a Paper shadow, and the dots are Ink with an 8 px Paper ring. The brand colours come out of the encode within 1-3 levels.
- **Footage colour:** the rendered footage is identical to the prepared source frames. Those frames match the clip decodes exactly: the coffee from the 10-bit HEVC decoded as BT.709, the Kling clips with the default BT.601 decode. The BT.601 decode matches the start stills within about 2 levels; BT.709 would push green up by 17. After the encode, footage differs from the render by under 0.5 levels on average and at most about 1.9 levels mean absolute.
- **Pulse and dots:** the word pulse is exactly 1.04 / 1.025 / 1.01 / 1.00 on all 10 cuts. The dot positions match the generator on all 150 frames, and no dot rises above y 277.
- **Tags:** spelling, joining and the dots of each letter are right, «؟» is at the left end, and the tilt measures 4.0° about (540,757). The glyph fill stays inside x 150-930, y 560-840: «قهوة؟» 217-849 × 580-819, «عطر؟» 282-787 × 582-824, «برجر؟» 297-766 × 629-823, «حلويات؟» 171-894 × 583-804.
- **Tag clearance:** on footage frames the product never comes closer than 50 px to the tag. The closest is the Burger A bun top at y 884.
- **Lens:** outer radius 340 at (540,1270) with a 12 px rim. The coffee, oud and kunafa products are whole and centred.
- **TikTok rail:** only the Burger B board edge enters x > 960, y 1100-1750.

I did not update tash/HANDOFF.md because this review step was read-only; the orchestrating session should record the result there. My measurement scripts and the evidence images (burger_drop.jpg, retouch.jpg, f180_touch.jpg, lens4.jpg, tags.jpg, cuts.jpg) are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-visitor-counter-api/1e0f8dbb-d731-5965-a898-07519c7bdbc3/scratchpad/r6/review/layout.

verdicts.reason: Measured the screen bun top at x 500-580: f225 1151, f226 1149, f227 1140, f228 1132, f229 1136, f230 1147, then 1145 at rest. That is 19 px up over f225-f228. In the source the bun top at x 540 goes from 1121 (n25) to 1101 (n31), with rest at 1108-1109. On n31 and n33 (f228 and f229) a blue gap opens under the bun's left edge: the whole bun lifts off the cheese, so this is more than the dome re-inflating. Tracking the dome against f239 gives a lateral shift of -10 (f225), +14 (f229), -16 (f235) and 0 (f239), a swing of about 30 px. Source n56-n72 all sit within 3 px in x and 1 px in y of n58. That is calm, though not '1 px' as claimed. The proposed fix holds.
verdicts.better_fix: As proposed: Burger B = n57-n71 at 1:1, keeping the 1.2x punch-in and the -10/-5 bump. In prep.py change the burger range to range(25, 72) (it now stops at n68). Do not keep n25 as a single impact frame: going from n25 to n57 pops the bun top 14 px up on screen in one frame. Shot B becomes nearly still, so pair it with the D-F5 slow push-in. Also replace the f480-494 band. The f105-119 porthole is optional, because at 0.31 scale the bounce is about 7 px.

verdicts.reason: Inner lens extent: y 542-1197 on f240 (centre 870), y 793-1447 on f241, centres 1295, 1262 and 1270 on f242-f244. With the 1.04 pulse on f240, the word ink ends at y 543 (no ink from 544). The rim top at y 530 therefore merges with the bottom of «مشروعك» over about 13 rows. In the full-size crop the ج and ر of «برجر؟» sit on the bun. On f241 the rim crosses the tag's descenders. The motion is ease-out (250, 175, then 33 up), not a fall.
